REEL — short animation studies

Three studies on timing: what an easing curve does to speed, what a spring does after it arrives, and what keyframe spacing does before any curve is applied. Each page is one file and every number on it is measured, not asserted.

  • 01Easing curves, one clockLinear / ease-in-out / cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) over an identical 1400 ms and an identical distance.
  • 02Spring vs tween, same targetA damped spring, solved exactly, against a fixed 700 ms bezier: overshoot, settling tails, and retargeting mid-flight.
  • 03Keyframe spacing is the timingThree key sets, straight-line in-betweens, one 1800 ms move: mechanical, hand-drawn, and hitched.

Each reel is a single self-contained file — no CDN, no build step, no network. Append ?still=1&t=0.42 to any of them to freeze one frame at 42% of the cycle.
